grid | chain:R4-PG-25:1 | grid_views.py, tests/test_line_bench.py | NEW file tests/test_line_bench.py. Power line bench part 1: the maths. At the end of grid_views.py add BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM = 0.05 and line_loss(voltage_kv, current_a, distance_km) returning {"sent_mw", "loss_mw", "percent"}: if voltage_kv <= 0 or current_a <= 0 all three are 0.0; else sent_mw = voltage_kv * current_a / 1000, loss_mw = current_a ** 2 * BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM * max(0, distance_km) / 1e6, percent = loss_mw / sent_mw * 100. Tests (game_env.module.line_loss): (110, 500, 100) gives sent_mw 55.0, loss_mw 1.25 and round(percent, 2) == 2.27; (11, 500, 100) round(percent, 1) == 22.7 (ten times lower voltage, ten times the loss share); (220, 500, 100) round(percent, 2) == 1.14; distance 0 gives percent 0.0; voltage 0 gives {"sent_mw": 0.0, "loss_mw": 0.0, "percent": 0.0}.
